Bottom line: Focus on managing your deeply underwater leveraged positions and protecting your capital.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL and SMCI further if they show weakness; the losses are substantial and margin amplifies risk.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
Respect the stop on CRWD at 147.5; it's your only profitable position.
